sources.primary_title: Snowflake deepens Saudi push with planned MCIT tie-up at LEAP 2026
sources.verified_angle_summary: Snowflake is set to announce a strategic initiative with Saudi Arabia's Ministry of Communications and Information Technology (MCIT) at LEAP 2026, deepening its push into the Kingdom's digital economy. The move builds on Snowflake's existing Data Cloud deployment in Google Cloud's Dammam region, which addresses critical local requirements for data residency and compliance. Beyond the MCIT tie-up, Snowflake will showcase its "Agentic Enterprise" model, featuring CoCo, a coding agent, and CoWork, a business user agent, demonstrating a shift from analytics infrastructure to AI-native workflow tools. The company will also highlight local use cases from Red Sea Global, O3sigma, and Zahid Group, and plans to host signing ceremonies to solidify its position in the Saudi enterprise AI and cloud market.
sources.verified_key_facts: Snowflake will announce a strategic initiative with Saudi Arabia's Ministry of Communications and Information Technology (MCIT) at LEAP 2026; The announcement builds on Snowflake's live Data Cloud deployment in Google Cloud's Dammam region; Snowflake expanded Saudi capabilities in 2025 with data sharing and added Cortex AI document processing in July 2026; The company will present its "Agentic Enterprise" concept, including CoCo (coding agent) and CoWork (business agent); Red Sea Global, O3sigma, and Zahid Group will present customer use cases; Snowflake plans signing ceremonies with customers and partners during the event.
